checkpoint_selection: lowest validation loss epoch (validation data only)
calibration: temperature scaling fitted on validation logits only; ECE (15 bins), NLL and Brier measured before/after on validation and test
test_set_use: scored exactly once per run, after the checkpoint is chosen; the runner hides test metrics unless --show-test is given

served_model.why: full improved configuration, lowest seed; fixed in advance, not chosen by test score

pilot.note: Measured on an Apple M2 (8 cores, 16 GB) CPU with other applications running (load average about 9). Values are 12-20 s/epoch depending on variant and load; single quiet-machine runs were 10-12 s/epoch.

dataset_id_note: Assigned by POST /datasets on the Supabase project (fashion-mnist, source fashion_mnist). Not the live-test-fashion-mnist row.
execution: sequential: one runner process, --seeds 0,1,2 (18 runs, one after another)
